accommodation.name: Onefam Amstel

paymentStatus.note: Per Hostelworld confirmation, room rate is non-refundable and fully confirmed/booked. €14.47 was paid online at booking; the remaining balance of €94.09 plus €12.06 city tax (12.5% local tax) is payable directly to the property upon arrival by cash, credit, or debit card.

accommodation.notes: Standard 4 Bed Mixed Dorm Ensuite, 1 guest, 3 nights (25-28 Oct 2026). Non-refundable rate. Check-in from 15:30 (24/7 reception), check-out by 11:00. House rules: age 18-40, no children, no pets, no smoking, no curfew.

arrival.notes: ✅ CONFIRMED - FlixBus Route 802 (direction Amsterdam Sloterdijk). Departs Bruges Station 16:10, arrives Amsterdam Sloterdijk (Platform Zone 1, Piarcoplein, 1043 DW Amsterdam) at 20:20 (~4h10m). Seat 20C. Price 22.48 EUR. From Sloterdijk to Onefam Amstel (Sarphatipark 58): consider tram/metro or taxi (~20-25 min, 25-35 EUR by taxi/Uber). Alternative from Schiphol Airport (if flying in instead): train to Amsterdam Zuid (7-10 min) then Tram 5 or 12 to Museumplein/Van Baerlestraat, then 5-10 min walk.

departure.notes: ✅ CONFIRMED - Super Sparpreis Europa (2nd class), non-refundable, seat-bound to ICE 141. Departs Amsterdam Centraal 05:45, arrives Berlin Hbf 12:50 (~7h05m via Hengelo/Bad Bentheim/Osnabrück/Hannover/Berlin route). Seat: Wagon 24, Seat 34 (mobile phone zone), reservation 805600008509. Price: 65.49 EUR. Ticket valid 28.10.2026 00:00 - 30.10.2026 03:00. Very early departure — checkout from Onefam Amstel (11:00 deadline) is irrelevant here; must leave hostel by ~04:50 to reach Amsterdam Centraal in time. Confirm night porter/early checkout availability with hostel in advance. Bring printed or app-loaded ticket + photo ID.

days.title: Departure Day to Berlin (very early train)

timeBlocks.name: morning
timeBlocks.description: Very early wake-up and check out, travel to Amsterdam Centraal for 05:45 ICE 141 departure to Berlin. Pack snacks night before - nothing will be open this early.

activities.name: Wake Up & Check Out
activities.notes: Pack and check out quietly (dorm room, other guests may be sleeping). No breakfast available at this hour - bring snacks/water from the night before.

activities.name: Transport to Amsterdam Centraal
activities.notes: ~3.5 km from De Pijp to Centraal. Night buses run in Amsterdam but check schedule - taxi/Uber (~15-20 EUR) is safest bet for a guaranteed on-time arrival at this hour.

activities.name: ICE 141 to Berlin Hbf
activities.notes: ✅ CONFIRMED - ICE 141, Wagon 24 Seat 34, reservation 805600008509. Route via Hengelo/Bad Bentheim/Osnabrück/Hannover/Berlin. Arrives Berlin Hbf 12:50 (~7h05m). Bring photo ID.

research_notes.notes: Very tight/early morning departure - confirm hostel allows quiet early checkout, and consider booking a taxi the night before for guaranteed on-time arrival.
